acme-api.name: Acme API
acme-api.desc: Acme API is a Python FastAPI service providing RESTful endpoints for the Acme platform, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

acme-web.name: Acme Web
acme-web.desc: Acme Web is a React storefront for the Acme platform: TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, with TanStack Query for server state.

acme-infra.name: Acme Infra
acme-infra.desc: Acme Infra is the Terraform + Kubernetes tooling for deploying the Acme platform on AWS EKS, with Helm charts and ArgoCD pipelines.
